title: Hit points follow damage until overridden
description: hp is a formula over max_hp and damage_taken. A hand override freezes it and marks it; clearing the override makes it follow its inputs again. Undo reverses the clear. The damage amounts (5, then 10) and the override value (30) are chosen by this transcription; the prose fixes only max_hp 27 and damage_taken 0.

expect.note: "max_hp: 27", "damage_taken: 0", "hp = max_hp - damage_taken": 27 - 0 = 27.
"hp = max_hp - damage_taken" is a formula and nobody has typed over it yet.
Nothing has happened yet; the log is empty.

steps.note: Aldric takes 5 damage (amount chosen by the transcription).

expect.note: "hp = max_hp - damage_taken": 27 - 5 = 22; the formula follows its input.
Changing an input is not an override of hp.
FIXTURES §8: a set is one group.
FIXTURES §7: the set is recorded as a write of the value.

steps.note: The GM types 30 over the hp formula (value chosen by the transcription).

expect.note: "Overriding `hp` by hand freezes it until the override is cleared; the inspector marks it." The override's value replaces the formula's 22.
"Overriding `hp` by hand freezes it until the override is cleared; the inspector marks it." The inspector's marker is on.
FIXTURES §8: an override is one group.
FIXTURES §7: for an override, the write is the overriding value.

steps.note: Further damage does not show while hp is overridden.

expect.note: "Overriding `hp` by hand freezes it until the override is cleared; the inspector marks it." hp stays 30 although 27 - 10 would be 17.
"Overriding `hp` by hand freezes it until the override is cleared; the inspector marks it." Still marked.
The input itself did change; only hp is frozen.

steps.note: Clearing the override makes hp follow its inputs again.

expect.note: "... freezes it until the override is cleared": cleared, so "hp = max_hp - damage_taken" = 27 - 10 = 17.
"the inspector marks it": with the override cleared the marker is gone.

steps.note: Undo reverses the clear; the override and its marker come back.

expect.note: FIXTURES §8: undo reverses the most recent group, the clear, so the override of 30 is back.
"the inspector marks it": the restored override is marked again.
Undo reversed only the clear; the earlier damage write stands.
FIXTURES §8: set, override, set, clear_override, undo; undo is itself a group and deletes nothing.
